cicatrices.ojo_bionico.texto: Lost an eye. The replacement sees better.

clases.vanguardia.descripcion: Front line. Soaks up fire and pins enemies down.
clases.tirador.descripcion: Hits hard from range. Fragile if caught.
clases.infiltrador.descripcion: Fast. Flanks and finishes off stragglers.

condiciones_mision.tormenta.descripcion: Nobody can see more than a few tiles. Fog for everyone.
condiciones_mision.noche.descripcion: Nighttime: fog and reduced vision. The enemy can't see much either.
condiciones_mision.interferencia.descripcion: Orders come through garbled: sometimes pilots do their own thing.
condiciones_mision.refuerzos.descripcion: Midway through the mission, another enemy squad arrives from behind.
condiciones_mision.francotirador.descripcion: A long-range enemy shooter waits in the back. Find cover.
condiciones_mision.minas.descripcion: Hidden mines. They blow up on anything that steps on them, from any side.
condiciones_mision.inteligencia.descripcion: You know where every enemy is, and the squad is on alert.
condiciones_mision.irrumpe_fauna.descripcion: There's a nest nearby: midway through the mission, void fauna storms in, and it doesn't pick sides.
condiciones_mision.irrumpe_contagio.descripcion: The area is blighted: midway through the mission, a horde shows up. They're weak but many: watch your ammo.
condiciones_mision.bombardeo.descripcion: They've got the coordinates of your drop zone: they'll shell the usual entry points as soon as it starts. Drop somewhere else.

enemigos.unidades.mutante_acorazado.descripcion: Shell of scrap and bone. Slow, but a pain to take down.
enemigos.unidades.mutante_bruto.descripcion: A hulking mass dripping acid. If it gets to you, it breaks you.
enemigos.unidades.mutante_tejedor.descripcion: Shoots filaments from a distance that jam the mech's systems.
enemigos.unidades.larvas.descripcion: A cloud of little bugs that chew on the mech's joints.
enemigos.unidades.contagiados.descripcion: Colonists the Mother already got to. They feel no pain and don't stop.

gambits.condiciones.siempre.ayuda: Always applies: put it last as the default plan.
gambits.condiciones.enemigo_a_rango.ayuda: An enemy is within weapon range and in sight.
gambits.condiciones.enemigo_cerca.ayuda: An enemy at that distance or closer.
gambits.condiciones.enemigo_aislado.ayuda: An enemy with no buddies nearby.
gambits.condiciones.enemigo_junto_a_barril.ayuda: An enemy is next to a barrel that can be blown up without hitting any of ours.
gambits.condiciones.yo_vida_bajo.ayuda: Their own mech is badly damaged.
gambits.condiciones.en_cobertura.ayuda: They're behind something that covers them.
gambits.condiciones.flanqueado.ayuda: They're getting hit from the side or from behind.
gambits.condiciones.moral_baja.ayuda: They're scared: their hands are shaking.
gambits.condiciones.radar_oculto.ayuda: Their radar detects an enemy behind a wall.
gambits.condiciones.enemigo_marcado.ayuda: An enemy was marked by an ally's radar.
gambits.condiciones.enemigo_cerca_con_escolta.ay: Enemies are nearby and the escort is in combat.
gambits.acciones.disparar.ayuda: Fires its ranged weapons at the target. If a wall blocks the target, fires at the nearest enemy it can see.
gambits.acciones.atacar_cuerpo_a_cuerpo.ayuda: Closes in and strikes. Needs a melee weapon (blade, claw).
gambits.acciones.suprimir.ayuda: Burst that forces the enemy to duck: loses accuracy for a while. Needs a machine gun.
gambits.acciones.disparo_apuntado.ayuda: A slow shot that hits for double damage. Marksman skill.
gambits.acciones.flanquear.ayuda: Circles the target to hit it from the side, where it has no cover.
gambits.acciones.seguir.ayuda: Stays close to the target. In combat, takes position beside it.
gambits.acciones.buscar_cobertura.ayuda: Finds the nearest tile with cover and stays there.
gambits.acciones.recargar.ayuda: Reloads even if it still has ammo.
gambits.acciones.reparar.ayuda: Repairs an adjacent ally. Uses the kit from the backpack.
gambits.acciones.desplegar_torreta.ayuda: Sets up a turret that fires on its own.
gambits.acciones.propulsion.ayuda: Jumps up to 4 tiles over everything.
gambits.acciones.muro_de_escudos.ayuda: Dug in behind the shield: heavy armor, does not move.
gambits.acciones.disparar_cabina.ayuda: Hits less often, but if the enemy mech goes down this way, its weapon stays intact for loot.
gambits.acciones.reventar_barril.ayuda: Shoots a barrel that has enemies next to it (best if the target is one of them). Never if any of ours are nearby. If there's no usable barrel, moves on to the next order.
gambits.objetivos.enemigo_mas_debil.ayuda: The enemy with the least HP.
gambits.objetivos.enemigo_mas_peligroso.ayuda: The enemy that deals the most damage.
gambits.objetivos.enemigo_aislado.ayuda: A lone enemy, far from its own.
gambits.objetivos.aliado_mas_herido.ayuda: The buddy who is most damaged.
gambits.objetivos.objetivo_mision.ayuda: Whatever the mission asks for (an area, a leader).
gambits.perfiles.agresivo.descripcion: Goes to the front and shoots the weakest.
gambits.perfiles.cauteloso.descripcion: Plays it safe: shoots from cover and pulls out if hurt.
gambits.perfiles.francotirador.descripcion: Keeps its distance and aims at the most dangerous.
gambits.perfiles.apoyo.descripcion: Repairs the most injured and stays with the group.
gambits.perfiles.escolta.descripcion: Never leaves the group and shoots whoever gets close.

generador_mapas.estilos.campo.descripcion: Open ground with cover scattered around. Whoever stands still out in the open goes down.
generador_mapas.estilos.rio.descripcion: An acid river cuts the map. There are few bridges: whoever holds them controls the fight.
generador_mapas.estilos.ruinas.descripcion: Ruined buildings with few entrances. Fights are close-range, around every corner.
generador_mapas.estilos.canon.descripcion: Rock walls close in. Little room to flank: you have to push head-on.
generador_mapas.estilos.deposito.descripcion: Rows of containers with aisles in between. Good cover, poor visibility.
generador_mapas.estilos.crater.descripcion: A pit in the middle forces you to go around the sides. Watch out for getting trapped.

habilidades.muro_de_escudos.descripcion: Digs in behind the shield: more armor, but can't move.
habilidades.disparo_apuntado.descripcion: A slow shot that hits twice as hard and lands more often.
habilidades.fuego_de_supresion.descripcion: A burst that makes the enemy duck: they lose accuracy.
habilidades.reparacion_de_campo.descripcion: Repairs an adjacent ally and puts out their fire.
habilidades.propulsion.descripcion: Jumps up to 4 tiles over anything.
habilidades.desplegar_torreta.descripcion: Drops an automatic turret next to the mech.
habilidades.marcar_objetivo.descripcion: Marks an enemy: everyone can see it, even in fog, and it has a harder time dodging.
habilidades.enganchar.descripcion: Drags an enemy up to 5 tiles away right up against the mech. Stunned for a moment.
habilidades.anclarse.descripcion: Drives in the anchors: +20 accuracy and more armor, but can't move for a while.
habilidades.desplegar_senuelo.descripcion: Projects a hologram between the mech and the enemies: draws fire.
habilidades.pulso_emp.descripcion: Shuts down the target's abilities and accuracy, and those of everyone next to it.
habilidades.sobrecarga.descripcion: Hits 40% harder and aims better for a while. Then runs hot.

misiones.defensa.descripcion: Survive {oleadas} waves without losing the core.
misiones.patrulla.descripcion: Cross the sector. Expect fog and ambushes.

nodriza.modulos.sensor.que: How many destinations you see on the Compass. At max, you also see what's at the signals before arriving.
nodriza.modulos.enfermeria.que: Pilots heal their traumas while traveling, without losing a mission to rest.
nodriza.modulos.hangar.que: How many pilots and their mechs the ship carries. Up to 6 deploy on a mission; the rest wait to rotate in.
nodriza.modulos.bahia.que: Mechs get patched up a little on every jump, at no cost at the Pit Stop.
nodriza.modulos.tanque.que: How much fuel gets loaded. A bigger tank means long jumps without a stop at a Pit Stop.
nodriza.modulos.casco.que: Absorbs fauna ambushes on long jumps and the tow when you run out of fuel.

partes.cabeza_radar.descripcion: Detects enemies up to 6 tiles away, even through walls. Unlocks «Mark Target» and the «Radar: hidden enemy» condition.
partes.brazo_gancho.descripcion: Fires a cable and yanks an enemy up to the mech, stunned. Unlocks «Grapple».
partes.piernas_estabilizadoras.descripcion: Drives anchors into the ground: can't move, but aims much better and takes more punishment. Unlocks «Anchor Down».
partes.mochila_senuelo.descripcion: Projects a hologram that draws enemy fire. Two uses. Unlocks «Deploy Decoy».
partes.brazo_emp.descripcion: A pulse that shuts down abilities and wrecks the aim of a whole group. Unlocks «EMP Pulse».
partes.torso_reactor.descripcion: Can overcharge: hits harder and aims better for a while, then runs hot. Unlocks «Overcharge».
partes.brazo_riel_valquiria.descripcion: A collector's-grade railgun: more damage, more range, and three affix slots.
partes.torso_bastion.descripcion: Recycled cruiser plating. Tougher than anything else, and hauls a ton of gear.
partes.piernas_fantasma.descripcion: Jump and run like nothing else. Very hard to hit.
partes.brazo_tormenta.descripcion: Colonel Ostrova's rotary gun. The only one in the whole belt. Comes with Overcharge.
partes.cabeza_ojo_de_varga.descripcion: The optics Varga ripped off a cruiser. Sees everything, through everything. Comes with Mark Target and radar.
partes.torso_yunque.descripcion: Plate on top of plate. Takes anything, but leaves little room for weapons.
partes.brazo_escudo_torre.descripcion: A hatch from a scrapyard with a handle welded on. Stops almost anything and weighs like it.
partes.piernas_patio.descripcion: Built for moving scrap, not for running. Armored to the floor.
partes.brazo_remachadora.descripcion: Drives red-hot rivets at close range. Punches through some armor.
partes.mochila_soldadora.descripcion: More charges than the standard kit, and more weight.
partes.brazo_martillo.descripcion: Slow and brutal. Sometimes leaves the other guy seeing stars.
partes.brazo_recortada.descripcion: Nuts and bolts at point-blank range. Useless past three tiles.
partes.torso_remolque.descripcion: Carries whatever you throw on it. The armor was sold separately.
partes.piernas_desguace.descripcion: Fast, with some plating. Heavier than a set of jump legs.
partes.brazo_soplete.descripcion: Never stops spitting fire. You have to be right on top of them.
partes.brazo_laser.descripcion: No ammo, so no reloading. Hits light, but never quits.
partes.cabeza_telemetro.descripcion: Sees far and aims better than anyone. Heavier than standard optics.
partes.brazo_lanza_pulso.descripcion: Two shots that split an armored unit in half. Then you wait.
partes.torso_prisma.descripcion: Light, with room for big guns. Made of glass.
partes.mochila_celdas.descripcion: Double the ammo for every weapon.
partes.piernas_colono.descripcion: Made for broken ground: great at dodging, bad at running.
partes.mochila_taller.descripcion: Four repairs in the middle of a firefight.
partes.brazo_clavadora.descripcion: A tool that learned to fight. Light, with a big magazine.
partes.torso_cosechadora.descripcion: Takes more than it weighs. Armor, just enough.
partes.brazo_arpon.descripcion: Punches through armor at mid range. Few shots and slow to reload.
partes.brazo_mortero.descripcion: Shoots far and blows up a whole area. Slow, with few shots.
partes.brazo_carabina.descripcion: The rifle the M7 wanted to be.
partes.cabeza_mando.descripcion: Radar and accuracy in the same helmet.
partes.torso_fragata.descripcion: Ship-grade structure in a mech. Hauls a lot and holds up well.
partes.brazo_m7_gastado.descripcion: Hits a bit harder, aims worse, and the magazine comes half empty.
partes.brazo_riel_recortado.descripcion: A railgun with the barrel hacksawed off: lighter, less range.
partes.torso_parche.descripcion: Plenty of hand-welded structure. Almost no armor.
partes.mochila_contrabando.descripcion: A lot more ammo, in drums that weigh a ton.
partes.brazo_lanzagranadas.descripcion: Explosives at mid range. Watch out for friendly fire.
partes.brazo_aguijon.descripcion: Still twitches. Stings fast and sometimes leaves the other guy stiff.
partes.piernas_quitina.descripcion: Run like the bug they came from.
partes.torso_caparazon_vivo.descripcion: A battleship shell hollowed out from inside. Regenerates on its own... mostly.

reglas.tareas.descansar.descripcion: Stays at base. Traumas heal faster, and they return sharp for the next mission.
reglas.tareas.entrenar.descripcion: Simulator hours while the others fight.
reglas.tareas.chatarrear.descripcion: Combs the junkyards: brings back credits and sometimes a part.
reglas.tareas.explorar.descripcion: Goes ahead to recon: the mission starts with no fog and adds intel on the sector boss.
reglas.control.ordenes.carga.descripcion: Everyone advances and fires at the nearest enemy, faster and hitting harder. Nobody falls back.
reglas.control.ordenes.fuego.descripcion: Everyone fires at the most dangerous enemy, with better aim, until it goes down.
reglas.control.ordenes.aguanten.descripcion: Everyone finds cover and fires from there, better armored. Nobody advances.
reglas.control.ordenes.replieguen.descripcion: Everyone pulls away from the enemy, faster and harder to hit. To save someone or to regroup.

textos.motivos_fin.escuadron_llega_a_zona: The squad made it to extraction
textos.eventos.0.texto: An abandoned freighter. Forgotten credits are still aboard.
textos.eventos.1.texto: A distress signal turns out to be a trap. They get out in time, shaken but intact.
textos.eventos.2.texto: An old mechanic gives them a spare part he doesn't use.
textos.eventos.3.texto: Quiet night in orbit. The pilots play poker and laugh for a while.
textos.eventos.4.texto: They find a busted satellite and strip the copper wiring. Every bit helps with the beer fund.
textos.eventos.5.texto: A hustler in orbit demands a toll so he won't scratch their mechs. Easier to just pay up.
textos.eventos.6.texto: They eat some vacuum-sealed burritos of questionable origin at the station. They spend the night in the bathroom.
textos.eventos.7.texto: They tap a pirate signal to watch the Galactic Super Bowl. There's tailgate barbecue and bear hugs.
textos.eventos.8.texto: They sweet-talk a scrapper into tossing them a spare part. «With a little duct tape, it'll still run,» he says.
textos.eventos.9.texto: Surprise inspection by Interplanetary Customs. They have to slip them a little 'courtesy' to be left alone.
textos.eventos.10.texto: Command sends a 40-minute motivational video about 'being a team player.' Pure torture.
textos.eventos.11.texto: Digging through rubble, they find a sealed bag of real coffee that isn't expired. They tear up.
textos.eventos.12.texto: They sell some space rocks as 'abstract art.' A trust-fund kid from the colony buys them.
textos.eventos.13.texto: They try to fix a servo with Super Glue and JB Weld. Miraculously, they put together a usable part.
textos.eventos.14.texto: They run into a convoy of politicians. They have to sit through a speech to be let through. It kills the will to live.
textos.eventos.15.texto: A pilot finds a 100-credit bill in the pocket of an old space suit. Cue the celebration!
textos.nombres_escuadron.3: the Last Ones on the Dock
textos.despedidas.temerario.0: «{apodo}» said this was a snooze and went off to find some action elsewhere.
textos.despedidas.temerario.1: «{apodo}» didn't even wait for the mech to cool down before signing up for another mess.
textos.despedidas.cobarde.0: «{apodo}» swore they'd never climb into a mech again, not for anything. This time it sounds like they mean it.
textos.despedidas.cobarde.1: «{apodo}» grabbed the cash and vanished in a puff of smoke. You won't be seeing them around.
textos.despedidas.sanguinario.0: «{apodo}» signed on with some shady types who pay per head. They're in their element.
textos.despedidas.sanguinario.1: «{apodo}» took off without so much as a goodbye. Honestly, did us a favor, they were a total creep.
textos.despedidas.leal.0: «{apodo}» wanted to keep the party going, but promised the folks back home they'd return. And they did.
textos.despedidas.leal.1: «{apodo}» stayed behind as a medic in the colony. «Somebody's gotta lend a hand,» they said. Good people.
textos.despedidas.general.0: «{apodo}» took the cash and says they're opening a garage.
textos.despedidas.general.1: «{apodo}» went over to the competition. They pay in hard currency and don't bust your chops.
textos.despedidas.general.2: «{apodo}» went back home. Promised to call when they got in; we're still waiting.
textos.despedidas.general.3: «{apodo}» left us on read over the radio and disappeared. Who knows where they are now.
textos.despedidas.general.4: «{apodo}» stayed to rebuild with the colony folks. To each their own.
textos.despedidas.nadie.0: They combed «{sector}». Not a soul left.
textos.despedidas.nadie.1: The rescue got to «{sector}» too late. Nothing but scrap for the salvage yard.

bandos.bandos.desertores.estilo: stolen military gear, cheap and worn out
bandos.noticias.lista.ofensiva.texto: {bando} launched an offensive and took ground from {otro}.
bandos.noticias.lista.enjambre.texto: The fauna came out to feed: the nests now reach farther.
bandos.noticias.lista.brote.texto: A whole colony fell in a single night. The Blight is spreading.
bandos.noticias.lista.escasez.texto: A refinery blew up. Fuel will cost more for a while.
bandos.noticias.lista.bonanza.texto: Everybody wants mercenaries now: new contracts pay more.
bandos.noticias.lista.saldos.texto: Plenty of scrap left over from the last battle: parts are cheaper.
bandos.noticias.lista.amnistia.texto: {bando} needs hands and is forgiving old debts.
bandos.noticias.lista.paro.texto: The pilots' guild won hazard pay for hot zones: wages go up for a while.
bandos.noticias.lista.tregua_rota.texto: Nobody respects the lines: the Front is moving a lot faster.

charlas.control_abre.0: Squad: hatches in sixty. Review your orders.
charlas.control_abre.1: Dropping on «{mision}». Channels open, chatter minimal.
charlas.control_abre.2: All units: final systems check. No turning back after this.
charlas.control_abre.3: Squad: hatches in sixty. Wake up, we're here.
charlas.control_abre.4: Dropping on «{mision}». Channels open, cut the bullshit.
charlas.control_abre.5: All units: final systems check. Anybody who whines later, tough shit.
charlas.control_abre.6: Heads up, it's about to get bumpy. Make sure everything's strapped down.
charlas.control_abre.7: Gentlemen, we're at «{mision}». Quit the card games and grab your controls.
charlas.control_abre.8: Hatches opening. Anyone who didn't buckle up, God help you.
charlas.control_abre.9: Dropping on «{mision}». Try not to wreck everything in the first five minutes, please.
charlas.control_abre.10: Last once-over, people. Got a spare bolt left over? Pocket it and don't tell anyone.
charlas.control_abre.11: We're over the zone. Put down the coffee, it's about to get bumpy.
charlas.control_abre.12: Wake up, sleeping beauties. We're at «{mision}» and there's work to do.
charlas.control_abre.13: Systems green. Or greenish-yellow. Drop anyway.
charlas.control_abre.14: Let's do this right today so we all get paid. Dropping.
charlas.control_abre.15: Listen up. If your mech makes a weird noise, turn the radio up.
charlas.control_abre.16: Landing in one minute. No crying on the general channel.
charlas.control_abre.17: Boys, spare parts are expensive. Look after your mechs' plating.
charlas.control_abre.18: Insurance covers third parties, not dumbasses. Drop carefully.
charlas.control_abre.19: Dropping on «{mision}». Scratch the paint and it's coming out of your paycheck.
charlas.control_abre.20: We're here. And please, quit burning missiles on flies.
charlas.control_abre.21: Hatches moving. Remember, workers' comp doesn't cover jack down there.
charlas.control_abre.22: Break something and you're paying me back in installments. Good luck down there.
charlas.control_abre.23: We're here. Treat the mechs like they're your own... wait, no, treat them well.
charlas.control_abre.24: Ready to drop. And don't bring me back scrap, I've got nowhere to put it.
charlas.control_abre.25: Dropping. Anyone who comes back on a tow truck can kiss their year-end bonus goodbye.
charlas.control_abre.26: Deployment imminent. Accounting begged me to ask you to burn less ammo today.
charlas.control_abre.27: Welcome to «{mision}», the prettiest place in the galaxy to die.
charlas.control_abre.28: Hatches ready. Go say hi to the neighbors with a lot of lead.
charlas.control_abre.29: All right, squad. It's full of ugly people down there. Make it prettier.
charlas.control_abre.30: The folks down there say you're not welcome. Go explain why they're wrong.
charlas.control_abre.31: We're over «{mision}». Perfect weather for handing out beatings.
charlas.control_abre.32: Preparing descent. Try not to die, I hate the paperwork.
charlas.control_abre.33: If you see something move, shoot it. If it doesn't move, shoot it a couple more times just in case.
charlas.control_abre.34: Opening hatches. Go down, do your thing, and be back before dinner gets cold.
charlas.control_abre.35: Heads up, the locals down there are rougher than sandpaper.
charlas.control_abre.36: We're at «{mision}». Time to spread love, hugs, and thermobaric missiles, boys.
charlas.control_abre.37: Radar says there's trouble. Radar always lies, but keep your guns hot just in case.
charlas.control_abre.38: Descent cleared. I'm going to make a coffee. Try not to explode.
charlas.control_abre.39: If a red light comes on, slap a piece of duct tape over it and keep going.
charlas.control_abre.40: All units: the manual says... ah, screw it, go down there and shoot everybody.
charlas.control_abre.41: Hatches in thirty. If you survive, we'll sort out that back pay I owe you.
charlas.control_abre.42: Air support is running late. As in never. You're on your own.
charlas.control_abre.43: Control here. The hatch button's stuck. I'll give it a whack and you'll drop.
charlas.control_abre.44: We're at «{mision}». Any complaints about your fate, take it up with the union.
charlas.control_abre.45: You have a green light. And if it didn't light up on the panel, use your imagination.
charlas.control_abre.46: Descent underway. I'm with you in spirit from up here, with the air conditioning.
charlas.control_abre.47: All right, people, time to put some skin in the game. Hatches opening.
charlas.control_abre.48: Buckle up, we're dropping into a hot zone.
charlas.control_abre.49: If the mech pulls to the left on landing, that's normal. Good luck down there.
charlas.control_abre.50: Listen up, kids. No screwing around at «{mision}». Or okay, a little, but carefully.
charlas.control_abre.51: Landing shortly. Get to work, money doesn't rain from the hangar ceiling.
charlas.control_abre.52: Systems ready. And don't play Rambo, I've got every one of you figured out.
charlas.control_abre.53: Dropping in. Last one to touch down buys the dozens of donuts.
charlas.control_abre.54: Brace for impact. Lock the doors tight, it's a rough neighborhood.
charlas.control_abre.55: Drop zone in sight. Start going down, I left my patience at home.
charlas.control_abre.56: Ready. If things go south, call for rescue... I won't listen, but go ahead and call.
charlas.control_cierra.0: Hatches open. Good luck down there.
charlas.control_cierra.3: Hatches open. May the Force, or Saint Whoever, be with you.
charlas.control_cierra.4: Contact in three, two... get to work, you lazy bastards.
charlas.control_cierra.6: Ground in sight. Don't scratch my paint.
charlas.control_cierra.7: That's it, see you around. Smooth landings.
charlas.control_cierra.8: Dropping in three, two... break everything except the mech.
charlas.control_cierra.9: Kiss on the forehead, now go hand out beatings.
charlas.control_cierra.10: Landing imminent. Cutting transmission before you clog my radio.
charlas.control_cierra.11: In you go! Last one out closes the door.
charlas.control_cierra.12: Well, I'm leaving you to it. Going to put the kettle on.
charlas.control_cierra.13: If I don't answer, I ran down to the corner store for some snacks. Good luck.
charlas.control_cierra.14: Ground in five. Try to land on your feet, like cats.
charlas.control_cierra.15: Descending. Anyone who cries on the radio gets muted.
charlas.control_cierra.16: Game time, kids! And don't embarrass me.
charlas.control_cierra.17: Done and dusted. Go down there and leave nobody standing.
charlas.control_cierra.18: Curtain's up. Go put on a show, you bunch of bums.
charlas.control_cierra.19: Touchdown in three... two... earn your paycheck, if you can.
charlas.control_cierra.20: Recess is over. Get down there and get your hands dirty.

charlas.tipo.defensa.18: Form a wall of five, and anyone who breaks it gets his legs broken.

charlas.tipo.defensa.36: Let's wait in the trench. Let them burn the fuel.

charlas.tipo.defensa.40: If things get ugly... dig in harder, you bunch of wimps.

charlas.tipo.defensa.44: Let's build a wall, made of bullets, lasers, and bad vibes.

charlas.tipo.defensa.47: Lock it down, people. Whoever walks in doesn't walk out with a dime.
charlas.tipo.defensa.48: First one to retreat buys the end-of-month barbecue. And meat prices are through the roof.
charlas.tipo.defensa.49: We dig in here. If it gets rough, keep shooting and die with dignity.

charlas.tipo.asalto.17: We catch these guys in their slippers. We'll flatten them.

charlas.tipo.asalto.20: Floor it. If you crash, make it into an enemy's face.

charlas.tipo.asalto.26: The guys in there are begging for a house call from the repair guy.

charlas.tipo.asalto.35: We're rolling over them like a train over a wagon.
charlas.tipo.asalto.36: If they blink, shoot. If they don't blink, shoot twice just in case.
charlas.tipo.asalto.37: We're walking in like we own the place, then wrecking the place.
charlas.tipo.asalto.38: We're giving these guys a surprise inspection, cannon-fire style.

charlas.tipo.asalto.43: I've got a serious itch to pull the trigger. Don't let me down.
charlas.tipo.asalto.44: The first one I see, I'm wearing as a hood ornament.
charlas.tipo.asalto.45: We're going to kick them out of their own den.
charlas.tipo.asalto.46: Let's go in making a racket, so they know the sweeper's here.

charlas.tipo.asalto.48: This is a stickup, pal. Hands up and hand over the scrap.

charlas.nemesis_apoyo.4: Let the jackass come. We'll give him a deal.
charlas.nemesis_apoyo.5: «{blanco}», leave him to me. I'll crack his chassis with a headbutt.
charlas.nemesis_apoyo.6: Easy, «{blanco}», we'll give this dumbass a full body-shop job, all of us.
charlas.nemesis_apoyo.7: If you've got him on a lease, «{blanco}», I'll back you up. We'll strip him down to the bolts.
charlas.nemesis_apoyo.8: «{blanco}», you call when we go in. We'll leave him begging for mercy.
charlas.nemesis_apoyo.9: Don't sweat it, «{blanco}», this guy's all bark. We'll take him apart in two minutes.
charlas.nemesis_apoyo.10: Let him get close, «{blanco}». We'll give him a full service, on the house.
charlas.nemesis_apoyo.11: «{blanco}», if he's bugging you that much, I'll hit him with a missile and we move on. Your call.
charlas.nemesis_apoyo.12: Relax, «{blanco}». This guy won't make it past the first roundabout, I've got you covered.
charlas.nemesis_apoyo.13: Poor bastard. Doesn't know that messing with «{blanco}» means answering to the whole block.
charlas.nemesis_apoyo.14: «{blanco}», let me dent his hood first. Then he's all yours.
charlas.nemesis_apoyo.15: Cut the suspense, «{blanco}», let's take down this clown, I wanna go eat.

dilemas.civiles.texto: A civilian liner is calling for help: pirates are boarding it. Getting involved costs fuel and exposes the pilots, but the captain promises a military-grade processor.
dilemas.civiles.opciones.0.exito.texto: The pirates run. The captain keeps his word: a top-shelf part for the workshop.
dilemas.civiles.opciones.0.exito.cronica: Saved a civilian freighter from pirate boarding.
dilemas.civiles.opciones.0.fracaso.texto: There were more pirates than it looked like. The freighter is safe, but {piloto} comes back with a mech in pieces.
dilemas.civiles.opciones.0.fracaso.cronica: Defended a civilian freighter; {piloto} paid the price.
dilemas.civiles.opciones.1.efectos.texto: They kill the radio. Nobody talks for hours.
dilemas.civiles.opciones.1.efectos.cronica: Left a freighter behind that was calling for help. Nobody brought it up again.
dilemas.desertor.texto: A pirate pilot surrenders over the radio. Says he knows the sector boss's defenses, but it could be a trap.
dilemas.desertor.opciones.0.exito.texto: What he says matches what they already knew. Valuable intel.
dilemas.desertor.opciones.0.exito.cronica: A pirate defector sold them his boss's secrets.
dilemas.desertor.opciones.0.fracaso.texto: It was an ambush. They get out of it with rounds still flying.
dilemas.desertor.opciones.0.fracaso.cronica: Fell for a fake defector's trap.
dilemas.desertor.opciones.1.efectos.texto: He signs the contract. We'll see if he's loyal.
dilemas.chatarrero.texto: A field of wrecked mechs, floating. There could be useful parts in there, or forgotten mines.
dilemas.chatarrero.opciones.0.exito.texto: A part in good condition turns up in the wreckage.
dilemas.chatarrero.opciones.0.exito.cronica: Salvaged a part from a mech graveyard.
dilemas.chatarrero.opciones.0.fracaso.texto: An old mine. {piloto} comes out with a scorched mech.
dilemas.chatarrero.opciones.1.efectos.texto: {piloto} flags the mines one by one. They haul off parts and scrap without a scratch.
dilemas.chatarrero.opciones.1.efectos.cronica: {piloto} defused the mines in a scrap graveyard.
dilemas.chatarrero.opciones.2.efectos.texto: They drain the tanks of the wrecks.
dilemas.enfermo.texto: One of the pilots woke up with a high fever. The next station has a doctor, but it's off the route.
dilemas.enfermo.opciones.0.efectos.texto: They make it in time. {piloto} recovers.
dilemas.enfermo.opciones.1.efectos.texto: The squad's medic doesn't sleep for two days, but pulls them through.
dilemas.enfermo.opciones.1.efectos.cronica: The squad's medic saved a comrade from the fever.
dilemas.enfermo.opciones.2.exito.texto: The fever breaks on its own.
dilemas.enfermo.opciones.2.fracaso.texto: {piloto} comes out of the fever, but something stuck.
dilemas.enfermo.opciones.2.fracaso.cronica: {piloto} survived the fever, but was never quite the same.
dilemas.contrabando.texto: A smuggler ship is offering cheap fuel. Payment up front.
dilemas.contrabando.opciones.0.fracaso.texto: They take the money and vanish. An expensive lesson.
dilemas.contrabando.opciones.1.exito.texto: Caught them off guard: free fuel.
dilemas.contrabando.opciones.1.fracaso.texto: They were armed. You leave empty-handed and with dented mechs.
dilemas.apuesta.texto: A mining station is hosting a bare-knuckle mech tournament. Entry costs 40 credits; the prize is 150.
dilemas.apuesta.opciones.0.exito.texto: {piloto} wins the final with the left arm. The whole station applauds.
dilemas.apuesta.opciones.0.exito.cronica: {piloto} won an arm-wrestling tournament at a mining station.
dilemas.apuesta.opciones.0.fracaso.texto: {piloto} loses in the second round and the mech ends up bent out of shape.
dilemas.apuesta.opciones.1.efectos.texto: A night of shouting and betting. The pilots laugh like they haven't in a long time.
dilemas.baliza.texto: An emergency beacon from another merc squad. You can hear breathing, faint.
dilemas.baliza.opciones.0.exito.texto: They find a pilot alive in the wreckage. She wants to fight with you.
dilemas.baliza.opciones.0.exito.cronica: Rescued a pilot from a fallen squad.
dilemas.baliza.opciones.0.fracaso.texto: Too late. They take her dog tags home to the family.
dilemas.baliza.opciones.1.efectos.texto: Nobody says a word while they strip the mechs.
dilemas.baliza.opciones.1.efectos.cronica: Looted the wreckage of another squad.
dilemas.tormenta_ionica.texto: An ion storm cuts the route. Going around burns fuel; going through takes nerves of steel.
dilemas.tormenta_ionica.opciones.0.efectos.texto: One more day of travel, no surprises.
dilemas.tormenta_ionica.opciones.1.exito.texto: They come out the other side with systems humming, but intact.
dilemas.tormenta_ionica.opciones.1.fracaso.texto: Lightning fries circuits. Every mech takes damage.
dilemas.mecanico.texto: A retired mechanic lives on an asteroid. He offers to fix your mechs if you deliver a package to the next sector.
dilemas.mecanico.opciones.0.exito.texto: He leaves the mechs like new. The package is heavier than it should be, but nobody asks.
dilemas.mecanico.opciones.0.fracaso.texto: He fixes them... and the package had a tracker in it. The pirates know where you are.
dilemas.truco.texto: A quiet night in orbit. Somebody pulls out a deck of cards.
dilemas.truco.opciones.0.exito.texto: {piloto} bluffs with a pair of twos and it works. The table erupts.
dilemas.truco.opciones.0.fracaso.texto: {piloto} folds with everything already lost. They argue until dawn.
dilemas.truco.opciones.1.efectos.texto: Nobody wins anything, but they get a few laughs.
dilemas.v_averia.texto: Mid-jump, the reactor starts coughing. Decide fast.
dilemas.v_averia.opciones.0.texto: Stop and patch it with what we've got
dilemas.v_averia.opciones.0.efectos.texto: They lose half a day and a tank purging the system.
dilemas.v_averia.opciones.1.efectos.texto: {piloto} leaves it better than before. With enough left over for the mechs.
dilemas.v_averia.opciones.2.exito.texto: It held. Nobody says a word until they arrive.
dilemas.v_averia.opciones.2.fracaso.texto: A jolt shakes half the hangar loose. The mechs slam into each other.
dilemas.v_polizon.texto: They find someone hiding in the cargo hold. Says they can fly, and that {bando} is looking for them.
dilemas.v_polizon.opciones.0.fracaso.texto: By morning they're gone. So is the petty cash.
dilemas.v_polizon.opciones.1.efectos.texto: They come to pick them up. Thanks given without a smile.
dilemas.v_polizon.opciones.2.texto: Drop them at the next stop
dilemas.v_polizon.opciones.2.efectos.texto: They get off without looking back.
dilemas.v_aduana.texto: A {bando} patrol boat cuts you off: «Inspection. Or toll.»
dilemas.v_aduana.opciones.0.efectos.texto: They pass without anyone opening a crate.
dilemas.v_aduana.opciones.1.exito.texto: A quick once-over, and they let you go.
dilemas.v_aduana.opciones.2.exito.texto: You lose them in the debris. They'll remember this.
dilemas.v_aduana.opciones.2.fracaso.texto: They land two bursts on you before you shake them.
dilemas.v_escombros.texto: The short way runs through the remains of an old battle. Something is shining in there.
dilemas.v_escombros.opciones.1.exito.texto: {piloto} comes back with something that still works.
dilemas.v_escombros.opciones.1.fracaso.texto: An old hull comes down on them.
dilemas.v_pelea.texto: Two pilots started throwing punches over something stupid. Everyone else is watching to see what Control does.
dilemas.v_pelea.opciones.1.efectos.texto: By the second round they're laughing.
dilemas.v_pelea.opciones.2.efectos.texto: They sort it out. More or less.
dilemas.v_adelanto.texto: {piloto} asks for an advance on wages. Won't say what for.
dilemas.v_adelanto.opciones.0.efectos.texto: {piloto} doesn't forget this kind of thing.
dilemas.v_vendedor.texto: A skiff clamps onto the hull. «Deals! This jump only!»
dilemas.v_vendedor.opciones.0.efectos.texto: There's a part inside. Which one, you'll see in the hangar.
dilemas.v_llamarada.texto: Sensors warn of a solar flare right on the route.
dilemas.v_llamarada.opciones.0.efectos.texto: Twelve hours in the dark and the cold. Nobody's happy.
dilemas.v_llamarada.opciones.1.exito.texto: They clear it before the peak. An enemy transmission slips through the static.
dilemas.v_llamarada.opciones.1.fracaso.texto: Half the mechs' electronics get fried.
dilemas.v_carguero.texto: A freighter with no lights, hand-painted quarantine marks on the hull.
dilemas.v_carguero.opciones.0.exito.texto: Empty of people, full of cargo.
dilemas.v_carguero.opciones.0.fracaso.texto: It wasn't empty. {piloto} gets out, but isn't the same.
dilemas.v_carguero.opciones.1.efectos.texto: One less infection source. {bando} takes note.
dilemas.v_auxilio.texto: A ship from another merc company, engines dead. They're asking for a tow on open radio.
dilemas.v_auxilio.opciones.0.efectos.texto: They pay what they have. Today them, tomorrow us.
dilemas.v_auxilio.opciones.1.exito.texto: They weren't in a position to argue.
dilemas.v_auxilio.opciones.2.efectos.texto: The radio keeps begging for a good long while.
dilemas.v_atajo.texto: The map shows an abandoned mining corridor. If it's still open, it saves fuel.
dilemas.v_atajo.opciones.0.fracaso.texto: Collapsed halfway. You have to back out, scraping the walls.
dilemas.v_cumple.texto: It's {piloto}'s birthday. Somebody suggests stopping to celebrate.
dilemas.v_cumple.opciones.0.efectos.texto: Ration-pack cake and terrible music. Everybody needed it.
dilemas.v_soplon.texto: A hauler claims to have fresh intel on the sector boss. It's not free.
dilemas.v_soplon.opciones.1.exito.texto: He gives it up for nothing: he can't stand the boss.
dilemas.v_soplon.opciones.1.fracaso.texto: He takes offense and hangs up.
dilemas.v_quitina.texto: The ship passes through the remains of a fauna molt. At the pit stops they pay good money for that to upgrade ships.
dilemas.v_quitina.opciones.0.exito.texto: {piloto} comes back with the holds full.

lore.encargos.defensa.0.porque: {enemigo} are coming to take {lugar}, and {cliente} has nothing to stop them with.
lore.encargos.defensa.0.buscamos: Hold the core until they get tired of coming.
lore.encargos.defensa.1.porque: {lugar} holds the last generator {cliente} has left. If it goes down, everything goes dark.
lore.encargos.defensa.1.buscamos: The generator still standing when the night is over.
lore.encargos.defensa.2.porque: {cliente} is evacuating through {lugar} and somebody has to cover the retreat.
lore.encargos.defensa.2.buscamos: Buy time. Every wave we stall is people who get out alive.
lore.encargos.asalto.0.porque: {enemigo} are using {lugar} as a base to hit {cliente}'s routes.
lore.encargos.asalto.0.buscamos: The one giving the orders. Cut off the head and the rest scatters.
lore.encargos.asalto.1.porque: {cliente} wants to send a clear message: {lugar} isn't theirs anymore.
lore.encargos.asalto.1.buscamos: Take down the leader in front of everyone.
lore.encargos.asalto.2.porque: There's a ringleader in {lugar} with a price on his head, and {cliente} is paying it.
lore.encargos.asalto.2.buscamos: The leader's head. The rest is noise.
lore.encargos.escolta.0.porque: {cliente} needs to get a truck through {lugar} and {enemigo} control the road.
lore.encargos.escolta.0.buscamos: Get the truck to extraction. In one piece.
lore.encargos.escolta.1.porque: The transport is carrying medicine for {cliente}. Without it, they won't last the week.
lore.encargos.escolta.1.buscamos: Get the cargo to extraction, whatever it takes.
lore.encargos.escolta.2.porque: {cliente} is hauling the last of what it has out of {lugar} before {enemigo} loot it.
lore.encargos.escolta.2.buscamos: Get the truck off the map before we are.
lore.encargos.patrulla.0.porque: Nobody's heard a word from {lugar} in days and {cliente} wants to know why.
lore.encargos.patrulla.0.buscamos: Cross it, see what's there, and come back to tell the tale.
lore.encargos.patrulla.1.porque: {cliente} is moving people through {lugar} and needs the route clear.
lore.encargos.patrulla.1.buscamos: Sweep the road and mark whatever's still hiding.
lore.encargos.patrulla.2.porque: Something is moving in the fog of {lugar}. {cliente} would rather we find it first.
lore.encargos.patrulla.2.buscamos: Cross the sector without getting buried in an ambush.
lore.encargos.duelo.0.porque: A squad of {enemigo} has been beating {cliente} for weeks. They want a squad just like it staring them down.
lore.encargos.duelo.0.buscamos: Beat them mech by mech. Let word get around.
lore.encargos.duelo.1.porque: {cliente} put money on us against {enemigo}'s mechs in {lugar}.
lore.consejos.estilo.campo.conviene.0.1: Open ground: whoever hits from range shoots first.
lore.consejos.estilo.campo.conviene.1.1: Good distance and nothing blocking the line of fire.
lore.consejos.estilo.campo.evitar.0.1: You'll get shot down crossing the field before you ever get to melee.
lore.consejos.estilo.rio.conviene.0.1: They hit from across the acid without having to cross.
lore.consejos.estilo.rio.conviene.1.1: For covering the bridges from a distance.
lore.consejos.estilo.rio.evitar.0.1: If you have to cross the bridge to use it, you're an easy target.
lore.consejos.estilo.ruinas.conviene.0.1: Fights happen around the corner: short range, heavy damage.
lore.consejos.estilo.ruinas.conviene.1.1: Between walls, whoever gets there first wins.
lore.consejos.estilo.ruinas.evitar.0.1: Walls cut off sight lines: long range isn't much use.
lore.consejos.estilo.canon.conviene.0.1: You have to push head-on: whoever's up front needs to take a beating.
lore.consejos.estilo.canon.conviene.1.1: In a narrow corridor, suppressing fire pins them down.
lore.consejos.estilo.deposito.conviene.0.1: Aisles between containers: they pop up suddenly and up close.
lore.consejos.estilo.deposito.conviene.1.1: Lots of cover, little visibility: bring something that can take a surprise.
lore.consejos.estilo.crater.conviene.0.1: They hit over the pit without having to go around it.
lore.consejos.estilo.crater.conviene.1.1: From the rim you control the whole crater.
lore.consejos.enemigo.infanteria.conviene.0.1: They come in swarms: sustained fire shreds them.
lore.consejos.enemigo.infanteria.conviene.1.1: One stream sweeps away an entire platoon.
lore.consejos.enemigo.infanteria.evitar.0.1: One slow, expensive shot per little soldier is wasted ammo.
lore.consejos.enemigo.dron.conviene.0.1: Drones dodge: you need accuracy, not brute force.
lore.consejos.enemigo.dron.conviene.1.1: With that many shots, a few are bound to connect.
lore.consejos.enemigo.dron.evitar.0.1: They fly. You're not reaching them with a blade.
lore.consejos.enemigo.mutante.conviene.0.1: Fire is the only thing that makes them hesitate.
lore.consejos.enemigo.mutante.conviene.1.1: They pile on top of you: you have to withstand the first impact.
lore.consejos.enemigo.mutante.evitar.0.1: They're fast and there are a lot of them: the rail gun charges way too slow.
lore.consejos.enemigo.mecha.conviene.0.1: Punches through armor like it's tin.
lore.consejos.enemigo.mecha.evitar.0.1: Bounces right off a mech's armor.
lore.doctrina_de_armado.pesos.ligero.origen: Frames from Fleet scout drones and Belt courier vehicles.
lore.doctrina_de_armado.pesos.ligero.lore: Built from cheap alloys and industrial plastics. The philosophy is simple: the best armor is not being there when the shot arrives.
lore.doctrina_de_armado.pesos.ligero.tactica: Ideal for dodging slow artillery fire and flanking. But they can't carry much: mount a rail cannon on a light torso and the recoil rips the arm clean off.
lore.doctrina_de_armado.pesos.medio.origen: Cargo exoskeletons, mining machinery, and port tractors.
lore.doctrina_de_armado.pesos.medio.lore: The backbone of the Co-op and the Haulers. They were born to haul crates around spaceports, but it turns out they're also great at hauling rotary machine guns.
lore.doctrina_de_armado.pesos.medio.tactica: The right balance. They can take a couple of direct hits and carry almost any weapon combo without overheating the motors.
lore.doctrina_de_armado.pesos.pesado.origen: Pure military scrap: bunker doors, plating from downed cruisers, and siege tanks.
lore.doctrina_de_armado.pesos.pesado.lore: Mountains of recycled steel walking across the battlefield. Slow as an asteroid and ridiculously expensive to maintain, but nearly indestructible head-on.
lore.doctrina_de_armado.pesos.pesado.tactica: The anchor of the squad. They draw enemy fire and have the power to run huge systems, like multi-missile launchers or plate shields.
lore.doctrina_de_armado.movilidad.bipode.lore: The humanoid standard. It copies basic biomechanics so any rookie pilot can walk without tripping over his own feet.
lore.doctrina_de_armado.movilidad.orugas.lore: Traction stolen from mining excavators. They give up all dodging ability in exchange for perfect stability for firing heavy artillery.
lore.doctrina_de_armado.movilidad.salto.lore: Designed for zero-gravity boarding. They use maneuvering micro-thrusters to leap over cover and land behind the enemy.

nemesis.origenes.bronca.intro.0: «{yo}» ejected from his burning mech while «{objetivo}» finished him off in {lugar}. He survived. And he never forgets a face.
nemesis.origenes.bronca.intro.1: In {lugar}, «{objetivo}» split «{yo}»'s mech in two. Left him alive. Mistake.
nemesis.origenes.bronca.frases.0: {objetivo}, remember me? Because I remember you.
nemesis.origenes.bronca.frases.2: You won't catch me with my back turned this time, {objetivo}.
nemesis.origenes.familiar.intro.0: The pilot «{objetivo}» shot down in {lugar} had a sister: «{yo}». She swore to find him.
nemesis.origenes.familiar.intro.1: «{yo}» buried her brother after {lugar}. She knows the name of the one who pulled the trigger: «{objetivo}».
nemesis.origenes.familiar.frases.1: He never did anything to you, {objetivo}. I'm gonna do plenty to you.
nemesis.origenes.familiar.frases.2: You know what his name was? No. Of course you don't.
nemesis.origenes.caido.intro.0: «{yo}» fought with us in {lugar}. We wrote him off as dead. He wasn't dead, and now he fights for the other side.
nemesis.origenes.caido.intro.1: When the squad went down in {lugar}, nobody came back for «{yo}». He didn't forget.
nemesis.origenes.caido.frases.0: You left me there, Control. Now it's my turn.
nemesis.origenes.caido.frases.1: Miss me? I sure missed you.
nemesis.origenes.caido.frases.2: I know your orders. I wrote them with you.
nemesis.origenes.oficial.intro.0: «{yo}» commands troops for {bando}. After {lugar}, he's got the company's name written down.
nemesis.origenes.oficial.intro.1: {bando} handed the problem to «{yo}»: you. Since {lugar}, he's been tailing you.
nemesis.origenes.oficial.frases.1: You were told to stay out of it. I'm the warning.
nemesis.origenes.oficial.frases.2: I get paid for every one of your mechs that goes home on a tow.
nemesis.origenes.desertor.intro.0: «{yo}» left the company with his mech and signed on with {bando}. He knows every order they ever taught him.
nemesis.origenes.desertor.intro.1: «{yo}» got tired of waiting. Now he gets paid by {bando}, and he knows how you fight.
nemesis.origenes.desertor.frases.1: Nothing personal, {objetivo}. Okay, a little personal.
nemesis.origenes.desertor.frases.2: You taught me how to fight. Thanks.
nemesis.tacticas.lejos.como: they took him down from a distance
nemesis.tacticas.lejos.aviso: He came back with a shield and thrusters: this time he closes the distance before they can aim.
nemesis.tacticas.cerca.como: they took him down in close combat
nemesis.tacticas.cerca.aviso: He learned his lesson: now he fights from range and doesn't let anyone get near him.
nemesis.tacticas.fuego.como: they mowed him down with pure firepower
nemesis.tacticas.fuego.aviso: He came back armored to the teeth: a hail of bullets doesn't even tickle anymore.
nemesis.tacticas.explosivos.como: they blew him up with explosives
nemesis.tacticas.explosivos.aviso: He's light now and never stops moving: missiles won't catch him standing still.
nemesis.final.muere.0: «{yo}» doesn't get back up this time. «{asesino}» closed the account.
nemesis.final.muere.1: Nothing's left of «{yo}»'s mech. It's over.
nemesis.final.escapa.0: «{yo}» ejected again through the smoke. Over the radio: «This isn't over».
nemesis.final.escapa.1: «{yo}»'s mech was reduced to scrap, but the cockpit was empty.
nemesis.final.sigue.0: «{yo}» pulled out in one piece. He'll be back.
nemesis.final.sigue.1: «{yo}» walked away without a scratch. And hungry for more.
nemesis.final.cobra.0: «{yo}» got payback on «{victima}». The grudge doesn't fade.
nemesis.replicas.0: That's what you said last time, {objetivo}.
nemesis.replicas.1: Talk all you want. I've already got you in my sights.
nemesis.replicas.2: I brought something special for you this time, {objetivo}.
nemesis.batalla.escapa.1: You won this one, {objetivo}. Now I know how you fight.
nemesis.batalla.escapa.2: Next time I come prepared for you.
nemesis.batalla.baja.0: One down. Where are you hiding, {objetivo}?
nemesis.batalla.baja.1: This is what happens when you mess with me.
nemesis.batalla.sobrevive.0: Not today, {objetivo}. But I know how you fight now.
nemesis.batalla.sobrevive.1: I'm out. But I'll be back. I always come back.
nemesis.respuestas.escapa.0: He's ejecting! Get back here, coward!
nemesis.respuestas.sobrevive.0: «{nemesis}» walked away in one piece. He'll be back.
nemesis.respuestas.sobrevive.1: We had him and he slipped away.

sectores.campana_base.sectores_def.0.objetivo: Varga «The Crane» controls the southern chop shops and charges a toll on everything that passes. Find him and take him down.
sectores.campana_base.sectores_def.0.jefe.frase: Mercenaries? Nobody walks into my scrapyard without paying.
My old man was expecting you. I've been expecting you more.
Everything that comes in here goes out in pieces.
sectores.campana_base.sectores_def.1.objetivo: Something is nesting beneath the abandoned colonies and the mutants are coming out of it. Reach the nest and kill The Mother.
She didn't die. She's in all of us.
sectores.campana_base.sectores_def.2.objetivo: Colonel Ostrova and her elite squad are blocking the way out of the belt. It's her or you.
sectores.campana_base.sectores_def.2.jefe.frase: Control, right? Say goodbye to your pilots.
Your squad is already a legend in the fleet. A dead legend.
sectores.campana_base.rasgos.aire_viciado.texto: No power, no refineries: lots of night contracts and fuel is expensive.
sectores.campana_base.rasgos.zona_militar.texto: They pay well, but everything costs more: fuel and wages.

sectores.campana_base.rasgos.minado.texto: Mines left over from another war: watch where you drop.
sectores.campana_base.rasgos.guerra_abierta.texto: The Front moves fast and contracts pay a little more.
sectores.campana_base.rasgos.ruta_comercial.texto: Freighters pass through nonstop: fuel and parts are cheaper.
sectores.campana_base.rasgos.sector_pobre.texto: Nobody's got a dime here: they pay less, but sell cheap.
sectores.campana_base.rasgos.radio_saturada.texto: So many crossed signals it's hard to give orders: frequent interference.
sectores.campana_base.rasgos.refuerzos_cerca.text: Nobody fights alone here: enemy reinforcements often show up.
